name: documint
description: Generate the same DocuMint Local Mode interactive HTML and Markdown documentation through a serverless, execution-capable Skill plugin.

interface.longDescription: Create the same interactive HTML project map, file navigation, search, diagrams and dependency insights as DocuMint VS Code Local Mode, using a bundled Node CLI when source and execution tools are available. Markdown fallback where execution is unavailable. No DocuMint server.
defaultPrompt: Use DocuMint to document this codebase from the files I provide.
Create a source-grounded architecture map and reading path for this repository.
Explain this source file, including exports, imports and important behavior.

publication.release_notes: Interactive HTML engine integration: DocuMint Local Mode source analyzer and HTML renderer now run through a serverless CLI. The installer bundles executable assets; Node execution capability is required for interactive HTML generation.
